import datetime
sheet = 'Audited data'
rows = range(408, 420)
clip_start = datetime.datetime(2028, 6, 7, 9, 0)
clip_end = datetime.datetime(2028, 6, 7, 17, 0)
worker_costs = {}
for r in rows:
    w = cell(sheet, f'B{r}')
    start = cell(sheet, f'C{r}')
    end = cell(sheet, f'D{r}')
    rate = num(sheet, f'E{r}')
    effective_start = max(start, clip_start)
    effective_end = min(end, clip_end)
    if effective_start < effective_end:
        hours = (effective_end - effective_start).total_seconds() / 3600.0
        cost = hours * rate
        worker_costs[w] = worker_costs.get(w, 0.0) + cost
sorted_workers = sorted(worker_costs.keys(), key=lambda x: (-worker_costs[x], x))
result = sorted_workers[0]
